name: uuwg/what-we-do
title: UUWG: What We Do
description: Секція 'What we do' — 5 карток-акордеон з напрямками діяльності.

item1Text.default:
We provide essential humanitarian assistance to Ukrainian families in Greece and to communities in Ukraine. Through our Humanitarian Aid Center, we collect, organize, and distribute food, clothing, hygiene products, medical supplies, and emergency tems.
Our aid efforts are needs based, coordinated with partners, and carried out with transparency and care.

item2Text.default: We support families in finding safe housing and navigating the relocation and integration process. This includes guidance, referrals, and coordination with local services to ensure stability during critical transition periods.

item3Text.default:
Education is key to empowerment.

We organize:

  • Greek and English language courses
  • Digital and creative skills workshops
  • Professional development and employability training

These programs help women build independent and access new opportunities.

item4Text.default: Displacement and war leave deep emotional impact. We offer individual and group psychological support, peer support circles, and well being workshops in safe and trusted environments.

item5Text.default: Cultural activities strengthen identity, connection, and healing. Through art workshops, community events, and cultural projects, we create spaces where women and children can express themselves and build belonging.
